'''Shia Letap''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]]. While hiding from the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|attacking]] the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], Letap was killed along with [[Sors Bandeam]], [[Jeswi Ele]], and [[Unidentified Clan|several other younglings]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] as part of [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Shia Letap was first mentioned by [[Leland Chee]] on the [[StarWars.com Message Boards]].<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=229415&start=60#11736018|thread=Casualties of the Jedi Order|author=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2005-06-06|time=8:56 PM}}</ref> She later received an entry in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]].
